topic: Expense ratio and why costs matter

slides.headline: Expense ratio explained in twenty seconds
slides.subhead: A small yearly fee that quietly shapes your experience.

points.title: The fee
points.text: A yearly percentage the fund charges to cover its running costs.

points.title: Built into the fund
points.text: It is part of the fund's value, so you never see a separate bill.

points.title: Why compare
points.text: Lower costs leave more of your money invested over time.

slides.headline: Know the cost before you invest
slides.cta: Save this for your next fund review
slides.footnote: Read the scheme documents for each fund's expense ratio.

caption: The expense ratio is the yearly cost of running a fund. You do not pay it as a separate bill, but it is built into the fund. Check it in the scheme documents. #ExpenseRatio #MutualFunds #FundBasics #InvestingBasics #SouthIndia
